name: node-agent-agent
description: The agent node: the only node that holds a model, plus its own page

node.desc: Hand a turn to the model: one that waits, one that just queues, chat history, what it is doing and what it has spent

priority.description: queue: wait for the turn in progress to finish, then take one of your own (default); interpret: put this line into the turn in progress

agent.description: which agent answers: a sub-agent's name, or this node's own agent when left out

chat.description: hand this agent one message; answers with the lines its turn added

priority.description: queue: wait for the turn in progress to finish, then take one of your own (default); interpret: put this line into the turn in progress

agent.description: which agent answers: a sub-agent's name, or this node's own agent when left out

chat_no_wait.description: hand this agent one message and do not wait for a turn: it is answered by a turn of its own (queue) or by the turn already running (interpret)

from.description: first message index; defaults to the newest window

count.description: maximum messages to return, capped at 200

agent.description: which agent answers: a sub-agent's name, or this node's own agent when left out

history.description: read a bounded window of this agent's transcript

agent.description: which agent answers: a sub-agent's name, or this node's own agent when left out

status.description: read this agent's state (idle / generating / calling a tool / stopping), the messages waiting behind it, and cumulative token usage

agent.description: which agent answers: a sub-agent's name, or this node's own agent when left out

action.description: provider selection operation; defaults to list

agent.description: which agent answers: a sub-agent's name, or this node's own agent when left out

provider.description: read or change this agent's active provider

agents.description: list every agent of this family: the main agent and the sub-agents it started, each with the topic and the state a page follows it by

destroy_agent.description: destroy a sub-agent: stop it, delete the transcript it persisted and take its name out of the agents list

agent.description: which agent answers: a sub-agent's name, or this node's own agent when left out

answer.description: answer a question this agent asked

ui.description: Talk to the agent: the whole history + one input box
